Public keys from connect responses are transient Redux data and stripped from persisted SDK cache.
storedData.network: stacks-wallet-network-url localStorage and addedCustomNetworks/removedCustomNetworks cookies contain public URLs, mode and chain IDs. Legacy network JSON is tested through the real provider.
storedData.recent: recentResults contains public search results (including SDK BNS owner). Exact old JSON remains loadable.
storedData.queries: React Query has no browser persistence plugin in this app. Memory/cache output and hydration compatibility are tested against stored-query-cache.json; read-only bytes remain hex strings, not SDK objects.
storedData.secrets: No application-owned encrypted mnemonic, decrypt/encrypt call, UserSession creation, signed-transaction storage or transaction-deserialization load path exists in production src. Secrets/signing are delegated to the wallet. The scanner inventories newly introduced secret/mnemonic/transaction codec identifiers as new boundaries, requiring a proof.
storedData.transactions: Wallet transaction/txid/signature responses are returned or ignored, never stored by Explorer. Fee sample unsigned transactions are transient; only serialized payload/estimated length and plain numeric estimates cross API/cache/UI boundaries.
